title: Actor
description: Who is acting on a request, as established by the auth module (Track C). Identity hierarchy: household -> parent -> students. Every module reads this; none of them establish identity themselves.

role.description: student: a child using their own profile. parent: the guardian, unlocked for parent-only areas (dashboard, consent, schedule and privacy controls).

student_id.description: The active student profile. Required for role student; null for parent unless the parent is viewing a specific child.
